title: Nexus Maps
description: Nexus Maps is the ultimate logging and remote management suite. Monitor server health, debug errors in real time, and visualize your server's economy flow all from a modern web dashboard.
body:
Check out the website:​
- Main page: https://nexusmaps.xyz/
- Subscription Page: https://nexusmaps.xyz/pricing
- Demo: https://www.nexusmaps.xyz/dashboard/NexusMcr/overview

🎁 Key Features​
- Overview - Log and monitor server performance such as player count, tick rate and many more. Allows you to review historical data from any time span!
- Web Viewer - See players moving and around the map real time within your browser and interact with them to perform actions.
- Watch gameplay from the past 1 hour!
- Player - See the current list of active players and quickly perform actions on them.
- Error Log - Checkout a list of errors that you may have missed on your server.
- Supported Addons - Quickly create a module of your own and start uploading data to the website! Allows you to compare historical data across any time span.
- AI Summary - An AI summary of the last 3 days of the servers logging to quickly read up on potential weak spots.
- Settings - List your server as "Public" to allow anyone to be able to view all the tabs mentioned above (only the creator can perform actions & error logs is hidden due to potentially sensitive logs)
- Want a new feature adding or an addon to be supported by base? Drop me a DM.
- View & edit MySQL database from the dashboard!
- Create, Read, Update & Delete files/folders via the FTP/SFTP panel.
